name: St. Nicky
source:
Be the holiday miracle for all the kids in Coney Island by stealing back a few presents from the police. Coppers on payroll, and kisses from Nicky, presents for giving, and bank vault visiting.... these are a few of our favorite things.

[From in-app]
translation:
从警察那里偷回一些礼物，成为康尼岛所有孩子的节日奇迹。工资单上的铜币、尼基的亲吻、赠送的礼物、参观银行金库……这些是我们最喜欢的一些事情。

[来自应用程序内]
